subject: Hybrid huddle: room zoning, mic coverage & cross-room transcoder plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, venue_ops@midcityvenues.com
Cc: eva_team_ops@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hybrid huddle: room zoning, mic coverage & cross-room transcoder plan

Hi team —

We’re finalizing logistics for the Horizon Financial two-day workshop (May 18–19). Main asks for this thread:

1) Confirm seating zones for mixed remote/onsite breakout huddles (we want 3 simultaneous huddles, each with 12–16 people). Attached is the floor map with our proposed zones.
2) Mic coverage: we need shotgun + boundary options so remote attendees don’t miss rapid Q&A. Marcus — can you confirm whether we can run a mic-sweep next Thurs?
3) Transcoding/bridge: Andrea from AVPartner recommended using a per-room transcoder preset to reduce CPU on the main bridge. Need venue ops to confirm network egress and any NAT/port restrictions.

No decisions yet — I want quick confirmations and any hard constraints by EOD Monday so we can lock gear.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Program Manager, Events
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ground_floor_zone_map_v2.pdf
From: Venue Ops <venue_ops@midcityvenues.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai, eva_team_ops@redwood.ai, andrea@avpartner.io
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid huddle: room zoning, mic coverage & cross-room transcoder plan

Jordan —

Thanks for the map. Quick notes from ops:

- Zones: Ground A/B/C look good for 3 huddles; wiring is already in-floor for A and C, B will need a 20m drop (we can run cable, estimate 45–60 min).
- Network: We have a dedicated event VLAN with 400 Mbps egress available. Outbound NAT is sticky; static port mapping for the transcoders is possible but needs a signed request 72 hours before load-in.
- Power: Each zone has at least two dedicated 20A circuits; if you run multiple transcoders you’ll need PDUs.
- Mic-sweep: We can do a quick sweep on Thu 30 Apr 10:00–11:30 if that works for Marcus. Bring your preferred mic set (we’ll provide the analyzer).

We’ll hold a site walkthrough with Andrea on May 3 at 14:00. If you want us to stage the transcoders in a locked rack, confirm in the next two business days.

— Priya
Venue Technical Lead
MidCity Venues

Attachments: none

> Jordan —
>
> Thanks for the map. Quick notes from ops: ...

Thanks Priya — Thu 30th 10:00 works for the mic-sweep. I’ll bring:
- 2 shotgun mics (Sennheiser MKH 416)
- 4 boundary capsules for table clusters
- NTi audio analyzer + laptop with sweep script

Preliminary results from our internal test (attached mic-sweep-log) show a null at 3.6 kHz in Zone B with the current speaker layout — short-term fix is to shift the forward rows 0.5m and add a boundary capsule near table 2. I’ll annotate the floor plan at the walkthrough.

On transcoders: Andrea, can you share the exact preset file you plan to use and whether it requires outbound TCP pinning? If yes, we’ll submit the 72-hour NAT request to Priya.

Marcus
AV Lead, Events
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid huddle: room zoning, mic coverage & cross-room transcoder plan

All —

Quick status and asks after site walkthrough today:

Decisions made:
- Zones: Lock to Ground A/B/C per the attached annotated map (Marcus’s minor shift applied to B).
- Mic configuration: 2 shotguns mounted front, 3 table boundary capsules per zone plus one ambient pair. Marcus will produce final mic rack list by Tue May 11.
- Transcoders: Andrea’s recommended preset is good (she uploaded transcoder-presets-Redwood.yml to the Drive link). Venue confirmed we can pin outbound TCP 5002–5006; I submitted the signed request to Priya for static mapping.

Action items:
- Marcus: final parts list + rack diagram (due Tue 2027-05-11).
- Priya (Venue Ops): confirm static NAT mapping by 2027-05-12 and reserved power strip location.
- Laura: share final attendee list and seating assignment (I’ll use this to label boundary mics).
- Andrea: drop any tweak notes for the transcoder preset (esp. GOP/frame rate) in the Drive folder.

Mike — FYI we’ve locked the AV path and will share run-of-show once parts list is final. Expect a dry run slot May 17 09:00–10:30 local time.

Thanks everyone — this gets us to a final tech run on the 17th. If there are any constraints (power, network, or staffing) flag them in the thread.

Jordan
Senior Program Manager, Events
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ground_floor_zone_map_v2_annotated.pdf, transcoder-presets-Redwood.yml
